storylines.summary: Accounting sends two dunning letters with the owner in CC; the customer tells the owner he never got the invoice; the payment arrives.
storylines.editorNotes: CC-only dunning mails (no reply from the owner expected); the customer writes in a new thread to the owner; the bank notice closes the invoice.

Servus Alex,

euer Tobias schickt mir Mahnungen für die RE-2026-0377 – die Rechnung hab ich nie bekommen! Schick's mir halt nochmal, dann zahl ich sofort.

beats.body:
Hi Tobias,

kannst du Gerhard die RE-2026-0377 bitte nochmal schicken und die Mahngebühr stornieren? Er hat sie offenbar nie bekommen.

Alex

storylines.summary: A packaging supplier says the discount was taken too late and asks for the difference; the owner agrees and it is paid.
storylines.editorNotes: Disagreement about when the discount period starts; small remaining amount; closure by the supplier.

facts: discount period ended 6 July (14 days from 22 June)
beats.subject: Invoice FV20260412 - open balance
beats.body:
Dear Mr Morgan,

for our invoice FV20260412 of 3,450.00 EUR we received 3,381.00 EUR on 9 July, i.e. with 2 % discount. The discount period is 14 days from the invoice date (22 June), so it ended on 6 July. Please pay the remaining 69.00 EUR.

Best regards
Tereza Dvořáková
Sales
Obaly Vltava s.r.o.
Tel. +420 5550 5401

tasks.title: Restbetrag 69,00 EUR zu FV20260412 an Obaly Vltava zahlen

facts: accounting pays the 69.00 EUR this week
beats.subject: RE: Invoice FV20260412 - open balance
beats.body:
Dear Ms Dvořáková,

you are right, sorry. Our accounting (in CC) will transfer the remaining 69.00 EUR this week.

Best regards
Alex Morgan

beats.subject: RE: Invoice FV20260412 - open balance
beats.body:
Dear Mr Morgan,

we received the 69.00 EUR, invoice FV20260412 is closed. Thank you.

Best regards
Tereza Dvořáková
